name: What are the steps involved in a professional kitchen tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What are the steps involved in a professional kitchen tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen tile installation follows a systematic sequence to ensure durability. First, installers prep the work area by removing old flooring and cleaning the subfloor. Next, they level the substrate and install an uncoupling membrane or cement backer board to prevent shifts and water intrusion. The layout is dry-fitted and marked with center guidelines to balance cuts evenly along walls and cabinets. Installers then spread thin-set mortar, embed the tiles with consistent spacers, and allow the mortar to set. Finally, grout is applied, wiped clean, and sealed to protect against kitchen spills.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves prepping the subfloor, laying an uncoupling backer board, dry-fitting the pattern, setting tiles in mortar, and grouting and sealing.
